cs.t: This has been my strategy, too - and the takeaway was that you were best off going with Miele. If that was a tad too pricey, Asko offered pretty much the same quality at a slightly lower price point. I think Miele just rebrands Liebherr fridges, though. I went with Asko and have been a happy camper thus far (Fridge, freezer, washer, dryer, dishwasher.) All have been doing what I expect them to with no fuss for 15 years now. Replaced the pump on the dishwasher once, cost approx $40 for the pump and took me fifteen minutes to replace.
